Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Second announcement.

I'll be running two tournaments at Dragon*Con 99
(July 1-4, Atlanta, GA). One DCI sanctioned
constructed tournament and one Bring-Your-Own
boosters Sabbat Sealed Deck tournament.

Note: For the Sabbat Sealed, players are to bring
eight (8) boosters. The number was incorrectly
given in my first announcement.

See http://www.dragoncon.net/dc/gaming/dcevtsec.htm
for more information.
